messages:
Maria (sec): FYI @channel - GitHub advisory for tokenizers -> 0.13.3 has a CVE where serialized metadata could be abused in some deserialization flows. Not exploitable in our stack directly but many downstream wheels were rebuilt. We should triage lockfile fallout and CI risk.
Jin (eng): Thanks Maria. Where was this reported? Any PoC?
Maria (sec): Link: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-xxxx-xxxx. No public PoC. The advisory recommends upgrade to >=0.13.4 or pin to 0.14.x. Transformers depends on tokenizers; our poetry.lock currently resolves tokenizers==0.13.3 in a few internal repos.
Aria (eng-infra): CI is already flapping for the runtime-image build on nightly — saw wheels rebuilt with different manylinux tags. ci-bot: `pip install -r requirements.txt` step failing with "Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement tokenizers==0.13.3" on manylinux2014.
Sam (platform): Do we need an emergency rollback or can we do a lock regen + constraints? My preference: avoid forcing a major transformer upgrade if not required.
Leo (devex): We can do a targeted lock re-resolve for affected services and publish updated wheel-cache images. Quick patch: add a pip constraint file forcing tokenizers>=0.13.4,<0.14 and then regen poetry.lock where necessary. Keeps transformers pinned.
Maria (sec): Priority: high for runtime and model-serving repos (latency-sensitive). Medium for internal tooling.
Jin (eng): Quick experiment on my fork: pinned tokenizers to 0.13.4, regen poetry.lock -> tests pass locally for serving. Transformers 4.32 still OK. I can open a draft PR.
Aria (eng-infra): Two infrastructure notes: 1) we should rebuild and publish the pinned wheel-cache Docker image for prod to avoid public PyPI shifts. 2) infra CI needs to accept manylinux tag variations for a short window until images are rebuilt.
sec-bot: New advisory linked in #eng-security by Maria at 2024-07-18T09:15:00Z. Issue ID INFSEC-472 created.
Jin (eng): I'll open PRs for: - poetry.lock regen in model-serving repo - pip constraints file addition - wheel-cache image rebuild job (infra)
Sam (platform): Add a step in the PR checklist: run the end-to-end model-serving smoke test and the perf harness (10k tokens/min) to guard perf regressions from tokenizers change.
Leo (devex): Also add a quick eval compare on a handful of prompts (sanity-check embeddings / generation latencies). If any output drift, flag for ML team.
Maria (sec): Decision: do NOT do a full transformers bump now. Short-term mitigation = pin tokenizers>=0.13.4 and rebuild wheels/images. Medium-term = schedule transformers tokenizers upgrade and run evals, target next sprint.
Jin (eng): Timeline proposal: draft PRs in the next 2 hours, CI run and fixups in next 6 hours, wheel-cache rebuild + promote in next 12-18 hours.
Aria (eng-infra): Marking infra blocker in our pipeline. I'll relax the strict manylinux matching for ~24h and queue the rebuild job.
Sam (platform): I'll coordinate deployment window to avoid interfering with high-traffic jobs tonight.
Maria (sec): Who will own the advisory response text for customers? We should say: "we've patched our build graph and are rolling updated images; no evidence of exploitation."
Leo (devex): I can draft the customer-facing blurb and send to legal for signoff.
Jin (eng): Opening PRs now: 1718675315-jin-tokenizers-pin-poetry-regenerate (draft).
ci-bot: CI run started for PR jin/tokenizers-pin (builds: wheel-cache, runtime-image, unit-tests).
Jin (eng): Noted a flaky test in runtime-image build related to file descriptor limits after the new wheel; reducing parallelism in test harness for now.
Aria (eng-infra): That flaky change looks unrelated but I'll keep the job red until images are published.
Maria (sec): Good triage. Follow-ups: assign INFSEC-472 to Maria, open ENG-788 (regen locks) owned by Jin, and INFRA-310 (rebuild/publish wheel-cache) owned by Aria.
Sam (platform): Thanks all. Let us know in #eng-oncall when images are promoted.
Maria (sec): Closing the loop here — will update INFSEC-472 with PR links and customer blurb. :thumbsup:
Leo (devex): Drafted blurb and shared with Maria in the PR comments.
Jin (eng): CI passed on the poetry.lock regen after pin, wheel-cache rebuild queued.
ci-bot: wheel-cache build succeeded. Runtime-image promote job enqueued.
Aria (eng-infra): Promoted runtime-image to the staging repo. Scheduling prod promote in 2h with Sam.
Maria (sec): Last check: any concerns on KMS/audit logs? No sensitive key changes—KMS unaffected. We'll add audit entries for the rebuild job.
Sam (platform): Confirmed audit entries will be retained for 90 days per compliance.
Maria (sec): Great. Closing thread after promote. Thanks everyone.
